config.reliable_remover.title: Reliable Remover Config
config.reliable_remover.option.show_remo: Shows a message above the hotbar when a restricted item is removed from your inventory.
config.reliable_remover.option.remove_cr: Hides restricted items from the Creative Mode menu.
config.reliable_remover.option.remove_em: Hides restricted items from the EMI side panel.
config.reliable_remover.option.remove_in: Removes restricted items from player inventories.
config.reliable_remover.option.remove_dr: Instantly removes restricted items when they are dropped in the world.
config.reliable_remover.option.remove_lo: Prevents restricted items from generating as loot.
config.reliable_remover.option.remove_st: If enabled, banned items will be removed from Chests, Barrels, Shulker Boxes, etc. when the block inventory is opened.
message.reliable_remover.attack_disabled: Attacking with this item is disabled.
